message:
Plan A is drafted only. Nothing is saved or registered, and your enrollment is unchanged. The draft is feasible: 13 credits, no rule errors.

- Capstone: I chose 90004 (CAP4000 sec 04, Mon/Wed 8:00-9:15) over 90006 (Tue/Thu 10:00-11:40). 90004 keeps your Tue/Thu mornings free. Both sections have 1 open seat.
- Linked lab: CAP4000 requires lab 90010 (Thu 5:30-6:20 pm), which is in the plan. It starts after your Thursday work block ends at 5:00 pm.
- Prerequisite: CAP4000 needs CS3000 or CS3500. You completed CS3000 with a B, so it is met.
- Protected courses: 90001 (Mon 10:00-11:15) and 90002 (Wed 1:00-2:15) are both included.
- Credits: 13 is within your 12-16 limit.
- Work hours: Your work blocks are Tue/Thu 12:00-5:00 pm. No class overlaps them.
- Time conflicts: None.

Tradeoffs:
- 90006 would also work. It has no conflicts, ends before work starts, and the lab still fits. It would put class on Tue/Thu mornings instead of Mon/Wed.
- Afternoon preference: Neither capstone option is an afternoon section, so I couldn't meet this soft preference. The afternoon section, 90005, is full with 3 on its waitlist.
- Current enrollment: You are enrolled in 90001, 90002 and 90003. Plan A leaves out 90003, so registering it would drop that course. I'll only do that if you ask.

Would you like to keep 90004, switch to 90006, or save the plan?
